$Comment: What the chest hidden in the restless graveyard holds, rolled fresh into it each time a party's graveyard is pasted (tools/arenas/Seasons_Of_Orbis_Restless_Graveyard.json names it on the chest): two to four Void Essence every time, then each Choice below on its own when its Weight, its chance out of 100, comes up: Uncommon Lantern Bombs and a Rare one. It holds no bone fragments, which the gate burns: the chest refills every visit, so fragments in it would make the gate free.
